lines.speaker: bar_engineer
lines.text: Halo's hand-built. Sixty quid of salvage and a month of evenings. It reads the room's signal environment and draws it on the ceiling in light, which is useless — completely useless — and it is the best thing anybody in this bar has ever made.

lines.speaker: bar_engineer
lines.text: Half this room works at Meridian and the other half wishes it did. Ask either half what they're building up there and you'll get a different answer, and both of them will mean it, and neither of them is lying to you.

lines.speaker: bar_engineer
lines.text: There's a vote Thursday on publishing the weights. Everyone in here is for it. None of us has a vote. That's the whole of engineering in one sentence and you can put it on my headstone.

lines.speaker: bar_engineer
lines.text: It's in the papers. All nine pages, clause on six and everything. This bar hasn't been this loud since it was still a machine shop and somebody dropped a lathe.
